decisions.reason: The camera sits at the core of the firm's space-optics heritage and still has its own page in a growing industry, so its results likely meet aspirations and nothing calls for problemistic search.

The modular multi-model navigation camera line fits the strategic shift toward flexible, compact sensors for small satellites, and slack from growth lets the firm carry it through long space procurement cycles.

Space situational awareness is a newer field with uncertain early results, but rising institutional demand, EU research funding and organisational slack favour keeping the suite rather than searching for other uses of its resources.

This radiation-hard camera line was only launched in 2024, has a page of its own and builds directly on core competences, so it is too early for any shortfall against aspirations to trigger withdrawal.

The asteroid navigation camera is likely tied to specific science missions and is only mentioned on the website, which signals less prominence, but its recent launch, mission-driven demand and available slack argue for keeping it for now.
